acceptance_criteria.criterion: RegularAction::setCallback(), getCallback(), hasCallback() exist and work correctly.
GridActions::getValueColumn() returns the stored column or null.
GridActions::processSubmittedActions() reads POST data, finds the matching action, invokes the callback if present, and returns the correct boolean.
StandardRow::getSelectValue() returns the string value of the value-column cell for the row.
StandardRow::getSelectionCell() returns null when not selectable, or a cached SelectionCell instance when selectable.
SelectionCell no longer extends BaseCell; its constructor takes only StandardRow.
SelectionCell::renderContent() produces a checkbox input with the correct name and value.
PHPStan level 6 passes on all modified files.

Refactored SelectionCell: removed extends BaseCell, standalone class with constructor(StandardRow $row), renderContent() uses GridActions field name helpers.
Implemented StandardRow::getSelectValue() and getSelectionCell() with lazy-init cache. Changed getGrid() return type to DataGrid (covariant override) to allow access to actions().
Added DataGridException::ERROR_NO_PAGINATION_PROVIDER constant.
PHPStan level 6: zero new errors (14 pre-existing errors unchanged, all in unrelated files).

comments.note: StandardRow::getValue() returns a RegularCell object (not the raw scalar), making its return type annotation array<string,mixed> misleading. For getSelectValue() we call getCell()->getValue() which is correct. The getValue() method is a pre-existing inconsistency not in scope of WP-001.

SelectionCell no longer implements GridCellInterface (which requires getColumn()) since it has no associated column. This is intentional. The renderer accesses it via StandardRow::getSelectionCell() directly. If a common interface is needed in future, GridCellInterface::getColumn() could be made nullable.

comments.note: processSubmittedActions(): passing an explicit empty array [] as $postData falls back to $_POST (due to empty() check). This is a testing footgun — a caller cannot distinguish 'no POST data' from 'use $_POST'. Low risk since no tests exist yet, but worth revisiting when tests are written.

comments.note: GridActions::processSubmittedActions(): the $postData parameter defaults to [] and uses empty() to fall back to $_POST. This makes it impossible to explicitly pass an empty array for testing. Prefer ?array $postData = null with $postData ?? $_POST to make intent unambiguous. Already noted by QA/Implementation — flag for a future WP when tests are written.

RegularAction::getCallback() uses a PHPDoc @return callable|null instead of a native return type. PHP 8.4 supports 'callable|null' as a native union return type — consider promoting it in a future cleanup pass.

StandardRow::getSelectValue() silently returns '' when no value column is configured. A grid developer who forgets setValueColumn() will get empty form submissions with no indication of the misconfiguration. A logged warning or a debug-mode assertion would improve DX.

StandardRow::isSelectable() is coupled to GridActions::hasActions(). A grid with actions but no value column will render checkboxes that submit empty string values. The two conditions (has actions + has value column) arguably both need to be true for meaningful selection. Low risk for now but worth revisiting when the renderer uses isSelectable().

SelectionCell uses constructor property promotion (private StandardRow $row), which is inconsistent with the rest of the codebase that assigns via $this->property. Not a correctness issue — cosmetic convention gap.
